title: DroneExecutionRequest
description: Cyber-physical ExecutionRequest schema for DROS Drone Extension (v0.3, spec ref: DROS-VEP-DRONE-PLAN-2026-v0.3 §13). NOT_PROVEN until validated against a live adapter (see T3-01/T3-02).

request_id.description: Unique nonce for this request. Used for replay protection (ATS-008).

principal.description: Identity of the requesting agent (maps to 6P Principal).

capability.description: Declared capability being invoked. Must correspond to an entry in the action taxonomy (§13 T3-01).

action.description: NOTE: adapter must explicitly declare which of these it actually supports; this list is a superset, not a guarantee (§13 T3-01).

target.description: The execution target (e.g. flight_controller.actuator_bus, mission_planner, parameter_store).

payload.description: Action-specific parameters (waypoint, velocity vector, actuator params, etc). Must be boundary-value tested (§13 T3-02).

runtime_posture.description: External, non-self-reported posture context. See drone_posture.schema.json. Agent self-reported posture MUST NOT be trusted directly (ATS-010).

posture_ref.description: Reference/hash of the posture object supplied by an external authority.

provenance.description: See provenance.schema.json. Must be cryptographically verifiable, not agent-asserted (ATS-009).

policy_context.description: Which policy version/bundle this request is evaluated against.

expiry.description: TTL / hard expiry timestamp (UTC). Expired requests must be denied (T2-04, ATS-008).

arg_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the full argument set, for tamper detection and deterministic replay (T8).
